items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: And there was a saxophone player... And we had...Billy Jones played the drums... A good trombone player, Lawrence Johnson.

ctx.x: Doc Palmer's band played all stocks?

No, they had some special arrangements. But this band had more writers. They had a lot of writers in it. And it was a little more modern band than Doc's band. So they asked me if I would like to play in the band, and so that was a lovely experience to be able to play that music. And they had a very, very good band. I remember some of the guys... Zeke Bradley, a good trumpet player, played with that band. Another fine trumpet player, J.W. Barnes. A good trombone player, Lawrence Johnson. They had a girl piano…
